breaking_news.headline: What a Monopoly importer learned when it tried to make things in the U.S.A.
breaking_news.summary: After getting hit with tariffs for the imported board games he sells, Jonathan Silva decided to see if he could produce a version of his Monopoly game in the United States. This is what he learned.

breaking_news.headline: EV battery recycling has a math problem
breaking_news.summary: For some electric vehicle batteries, it costs more to recycle them than they're worth. That creates all kinds of problems, which a new Colorado law aims to solve.

breaking_news.headline: States sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros blockbuster merger
breaking_news.summary: California is among the states suing to block Paramount from buying Warner Bros. Discovery in a Hollywood mega-merger that would unite some of the nation's largest movie studios and TV newsrooms.

breaking_news.headline: 'The Trojan Teddy Bear': The promise and peril of childhood in the age of AI
breaking_news.summary: AI is moving beyond chatbots and into toys, dolls, and robots built to befriend children. A leading child-development expert says the technology offers real promise — but also risks crowding out the human relationships children need most.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation slowed sharply -- but it may not last
breaking_news.summary: Annual inflation hit 3.5% in June, down from May's more than three-year high — but the resumption of the conflict with Iran threaten to push up inflation as energy costs once again spike.

breaking_news.headline: Mystery bidder buys T. rex nicknamed 'Gus' for a record $50 million
breaking_news.summary: A T-rex fossil billed as one of the world's largest specimens was sold for a record $50.1 million Tuesday to a mystery bidder. But many aren't happy about it.

breaking_news.headline: American AI is expensive. Some startups are turning to cheap Chinese models
breaking_news.summary: AI is a fast-growing business expense. Some companies are cutting costs by switching to cheaper Chinese AI models.

breaking_news.headline: China's economy grows 4.3% in Q2, slowest since late 2022
breaking_news.summary: Lagging consumer spending and business investment offset the boost from strong exports thanks partly to the boom in artificial intelligence.

breaking_news.headline: Volunteer firefighter suspected of starting devastating France forest fire
breaking_news.summary: President Macron said there would be no leniency for arsonists, as France - along with much of Europe - deals with a series of unusual heatwaves.

breaking_news.headline: 'Moment of joy' as Uganda discharges last Ebola patient
breaking_news.summary: Most of the recent cases were among travellers from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

breaking_news.headline: Argentina face action over Falklands banner
breaking_news.summary: Argentina face the prospect of disciplinary action from Fifa after their players celebrate the World Cup semi-final win against England with a banner in support of their country's claims to the Falkland Islands.

breaking_news.headline: More than 800 Canadian wildfires burning as air quality alerts extend to US
breaking_news.summary: The air quality in large parts of Michigan, Minneapolis and Minnesota is deemed "hazardous" by authorities.

breaking_news.headline: Iran targets military bases as US launches wave of strikes
breaking_news.summary: Explosions were heard across Iran overnight, shortly after neighbouring Gulf states began to report attacks.

breaking_news.headline: Teenager accused of carrying out sabotage actions in Poland for Russia
breaking_news.summary: Polish security services say the aim was to incite ethnic tensions between Poland and Ukraine.

breaking_news.headline: Protests in Ukrainian cities against Zelensky's removal of defence minister
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's president has not explained Mykhailo Fedorov's dismissal, which is causing great upset among civil society and the military.

breaking_news.headline: Italian officials handed jail terms for Genoa bridge disaster that killed 43
breaking_news.summary: The ex-head of Italy's motorway operator Giovanni Castellucci was handed a 12-year term over the 2018 bridge collapse.

breaking_news.headline: Buffett calls Bill Gates relationship with Epstein 'distasteful'
breaking_news.summary: The billionaire investor's firm has stopped giving donations to the Microsoft co-founder's charity.

breaking_news.headline: Chip giant TSMC pledges another $100bn to expand US production
breaking_news.summary: The company says it will create "high-tech, high-paying jobs", and raises its total commitment to the US to $265bn.

breaking_news.headline: TikTok faces Ofcom investigation over child age checks
breaking_news.summary: It follows a review by the regulator in May that criticised the platform for not being "safe enough" for children.

breaking_news.headline: UK economy returns to growth in May
breaking_news.summary: The modest growth reverses a slight contraction that had been seen the previous month.
